display_name: 归一化频率优化＋全骨干半监督续训（三种子21行）
description: 频率FP64 master f/fs；三档物理步长与普通权重大LR分离；固定40epoch，沿用合法Us半监督与多解耦有限动作。
authorization: 用户恢复半监督，允许混合方法、多方案利用八卡；进一步明确增加权重调优力度。每卡最多3总进程，原始纯CE E200→E40，自动clean。

execution.gpu_policy: max3 total processes perGPU including S batch; remaining capacity only

physical.objective: maximize fixed-parent true-IQ logit-margin drop; fixed classifier scale 30

temporal.phase_process: three smooth sine modes; clipped Gaussian coefficients

fractional_delay.operator: zero-pad 256 each side, FFT phase shift, crop original central 256
fractional_delay.zero_delay: exact value identity with differentiable delay path
fractional_delay.boundary_assumption: IQ outside observed 256-sample window is zero; sinc interpolation may ring near truncated edges
fractional_delay.scope: new fixed mild timing perturbation, not satellite/channel simulation or calibrated source error

physical.random: explicit private CPU generators; no global RNG consumption

physical_actions.coordinates: all four tanh(raw); temporal noise abs; then registered Linfinity normalization
physical_actions.fit: Original E200 frozen, fresh initialization, full L_s raw-margin pass then finite-risk pass
physical_actions.identity_training: Frozen source-L-fitted LT only; identity uses lawful source L/U semi; teacher never fits actions; no satellite
